semantic_fixtures.covers: copies an opponent creature with haste through the turn, then restores Cursed Mirror and its red mana ability

the later Clever Impersonator copy replaces Mirror's temporary copy while Black Vise's linked opponent choice remains stable
a later Clone copy choice replaces the earlier Mirror copy and haste exception
copy expiry moves an illegal Aura, detaches Equipment, preserves counters/tap/ObjectId/generation, emits a current battlefield view, and preserves cleanup SBA priority
another object copies Mirror's copiable haste but not its cleanup duration
declining the optional copy choice leaves the printed artifact and red mana ability
